attacker_monitors_mempool.meaning: attacker observes the protocol's liquidity addition transaction in the public mempool

price_validation_present.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange validates current pool price against TWAP or historical baseline

deadline_is_block_timestamp.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange uses block.timestamp as deadline so no execution delay applies

liquidity_value_received.meaning: liquidity value the protocol receives for the assets provided in the addition

liquidity_value_commensurate.meaning: protocol receives liquidity value commensurate with the assets provided (no sandwich extraction)

assumptions: The protocol's liquidity addition transaction is observable in the public mempool before inclusion.
A sandwich attacker can move the pool price before and after the addition within the same block.
The assets provided by the protocol are fixed for the addition being evaluated.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of the fair/commensurate liquidity value or the assets provided, so the value relation is carried by a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic comparison.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the i_less_liquidity_value impact; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
The commensurate-value relation is qualitative in the report; no numeric fair-value baseline is supplied.
Whether the attacker is permissionless is not stated; the condition uses only the mempool-observability fact.
